meta.name: context-driven-development
meta.description: Creates and maintains project context artifacts (product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md) in a `conductor/` directory. Scaffolds new projects from scratch, extracts context from existing codebases, validates artifact consistency before implementation, and synchronizes documents as the project evolves. Use when setting up a project, creating or updating product docs, managing a tech stack file, defining development workflows, tracking work units, onboarding to an existing codebase, or running project scaffolding.

howto.what: 它会在项目里建一个 conductor/ 目录，写和维护四个上下文文件：product.md、tech-stack.md、workflow.md、tracks.md；可用来从零搭新项目、从已有代码库提取上下文，并在动工前校验这些文件是否一致。
howto.when: 当你搭建项目、创建或更新产品文档、管理技术栈文件等时触发；接手已有代码库、定义开发流程等上下文相关操作也会用到。

howto.what_en: It creates and maintains four context files (product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md) in a conductor/ directory: scaffolding new projects, extracting context from existing codebases, and checking consistency before implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up a project, create or update product docs, manage a tech stack file and similar; also for onboarding to an existing codebase or defining workflows.
